title: Pinned MediaPipe dependency license text inventory
status: Notice-text preparation only; not complete corresponding source, exact link membership, package clearance, or legal advice.
scope: Official upstream root license/notice text for the target-relevant dependency candidates enumerated in the retained MediaPipe closure table.
source_context: The selected Windows MediaPipe target is link-static, but the exact linked-component/action graph is unavailable. Rows are candidate dependencies, not a claim that each is present in the shipped binary.

retrieval.method: Fetched small plain-text license files from official upstream raw/GitLab URLs at the recorded pinned commit or release tag.
retrieval.note: No requested exact license URL was inaccessible. Root-level file listings were checked at the same refs; absence of a separate root NOTICE does not imply absence of nested third-party notices.
